column2: Become light and leap between nearby enemies five times, striking each (invincible meanwhile)
Crystal pillars of light rise under five nearby enemies and launch them skyward
The world stops and sky and earth turn into a sea of stars. Clench your fist and the world cracks; strike and it shatters, breaking every enemy with it
Only a Limitless master who knows the Genesis Fist meets the Fist Sovereign on the Sun-Moon Altar at the far southeast
The summit of all styles. The sun in the right hand, the moon in the left. Burns like the sun by day, cuts like the moon by night, and in the final move the two overlap into an eclipse.
Sun-Moon: every three hits the sun and moon fall in turn (the sun explodes, the moon cuts). By day damage dealt +15%, by night damage taken -15%. All skill cooldowns 25% shorter
Throw a crescent of light as big as a full moon. It pierces and cuts every enemy ahead
Small suns fall on six nearby enemies and burst into pillars of fire
The sky turns to night and the sun and moon rise together. Moonlight cuts the area, the two overlap into an eclipse, rays of the black sun pierce every enemy, then it bursts like dawn
A style that holds the endless sea in two hands. If Flowing Water receives and redirects, Azure Sea is the wave that rolls in and swallows everything. Once pushed, you're swept to the end.
Waves: every four hits a water pillar rises at the target and sweeps the area. All knockback x1.3
Slide forward on a wave, piercing through (invincible). Spray bursts along your path
Walls of water rise ahead one after another, sweeping a line and pushing enemies far away
The sea behind you stands up. A towering tsunami rolls forward dragging every enemy, then breaks into a giant whirlpool
Only a Limitless master who knows the Genesis Fist meets the Eternal Elder before the floating gate atop the thousand stairs in the far northwest
A fist that holds time. Time stops for those it hits, and past blows echo back to strike again. The final move opens a giant sundial in the sky and a bell tolls twelve times.
Stop: every five hits time stops around the target for 1.4s and an echo strikes. All skill cooldowns 30% shorter, action speed +10%
Pierce forward (invincible), then 0.6s later time rewinds and you return to your spot, cutting enemies on the path again
Open a zone of stopped time ahead for 2s. Enemies inside can't move and are cut with every tick
A giant sundial opens in the sky and its hand turns backward. Time stops for every nearby enemy, they're cut each time the bell tolls twelve, and at midnight time shatters
A fist that holds a burning flame. Those it hits keep burning, and a heavy strike on a burning enemy explodes.
Burn: enemies hit burn for 3s (damage every 0.5s). A heavy strike (Z) on a burning enemy explodes and burns the area
Become flame and pierce forward (invincible). Fire pillars rise along your path
Breathe fire in a cone ahead for 1.2s (enemies hit burn)
The ground splits and lava flows under every nearby enemy, raising a fire pillar on each. At the end a volcano erupts where you stand
Only those who defeat one hundred players in the Battleground gain the martial world's finest dueling style
The fist of one who has defeated a hundred in the Battleground. No flourish, honed only to beat opponents. Each takedown restores your breath.
Peerless: +20% damage against players. Each takedown restores 10% HP and 20 Ki. Wide deflect window
Dart in like lightning and cut through every enemy ahead (invincible)
Unleash fists and kicks in every direction (1.2s)
A fence of light traps the area and pulls every enemy to the center. Eight blows, then a final fist launches them high into the sky
Somewhere in the Heavenly Realm lies a small island where the air is cracked. Only a Half-Immortal master who crosses the invisible bridge meets the Subspace Sage
The fist of an old man who lives in the cracks of space. Space folds wherever it lands, and its secret art opens a space cut off from the outside.
Rift: 1.4x from behind. Skill cooldowns 15% shorter, and you can dodge twice in a row
Fold space and appear behind the nearest enemy to strike (critical)
Tear the space ahead, pulling in and cutting nearby enemies for 1.5s
Open a space cut off from the outside. For 10s enemies inside can't escape and are cut from all sides. At the end the space closes and explodes
Push palms like flowing clouds to scatter enemies. Not strong, but light on your feet and good for escaping.
Cloud Step: dodge twice in a row, wide deflect window. Palms push enemies far away
Glide forward as if on clouds, hitting enemies you pass (invincible)
Spread a cloud vortex ahead, hitting nearby enemies for 1s
A sea of clouds spreads wide underfoot, hitting every nearby enemy for 2s
In the deepest part of the Nebula Garden, behind the Star Lord, an old man counts the stars. He shows the path of stars only to those at Ascension
A fist that holds the river of stars. Starlight scatters wherever it lands, and its secret art opens a galaxy overhead that rains stars.
Starry River: balance damage x1.5, skill cooldowns 20% shorter
Charge like a meteor trailing its tail, piercing enemies ahead (invincible)
Raise a vortex of stars around you, pulling in and hitting enemies for 1.4s
A galaxy opens overhead and stars spiral down twenty-four times, then a star bursts at the center
Legs that kick the wind. In and out like wind that can't be caught or blocked. Blades of wind linger where your feet pass.
Gale: short dash cooldown (0.6s), and kicks raise wind that launches enemies farther (knockback x1.3)
Pierce through like the wind (invincible). Wind blades left on your path cut again
Raise a tornado ahead for 2.5s. It pulls in and keeps cutting nearby enemies
A huge tornado rises and moves forward, sucking up every enemy, then hurls them in all directions at the end
Fully awaken the Blood Demon Hand and gain two insights, then beat your blood-soaked shadow in the Awakening Trial
The Blood Demon's hand has recognized its master and awakened. The blood at your nails boils gold. Every skill of the Blood Demon Hand, only deeper and redder.
True Lifesteal: heal 3% of damage dealt (1.5x during frenzy, per 1s up to 5% of max HP). All skills x1.5. True Blood Demon Descends: a bigger Blood Demon tears six times, frenzy 10s
A giant Blood Demon rises behind you, tears enemies six times with its claws and roars. Then 10s of frenzy (speed x1.2, lifesteal x1.5)
Fully awaken the Heavenly Dragon Palm and gain two insights, then beat your gold-dragon-clad shadow in the Awakening Trial
The blue dragon shed its skin and became a golden true dragon. Blasts charge faster, and the dragon from the ground covers the whole sky.
True Dragon Charge: a full blast in 1s. All skills x1.5. True Dragon Descends: a giant gold dragon slams five times and breathes bigger
A giant gold dragon bursts from the ground, slams the enemy five times, then breathes a huge blast forward
Fully awaken the Thunderclap Fist and gain two insights, then beat your shadow of purple lightning in the Awakening Trial
Yellow lightning has become purple heavenly thunder. The sound bursts before the fist lands, and chain lightning jumps farther and harder.
True Charge: four hits for chain heavenly thunder (wider and stronger). All skills x1.5. True Thunder God Form: eleven jumps and the sky cracks open
Your body becomes purple heavenly thunder and jumps between enemies eleven times. Lightning falls at each touch, and at the end the sky cracks open
Fully awaken the Diamond Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, beat your golden-Buddha shadow in the Awakening Trial
Diamond has awakened in your reborn body. Your body itself is now the weapon. The more you're hit, the harder you get, and stored impact returns as ground-shaking tremors.

Indestructible: 30% less damage taken. Every eight hits taken (blocks count) a diamond tremor bursts from you and throws the area. Secret Art Ten Thousand Buddhas: a giant golden palm descends from the sky and presses the ground
A golden bell covers you for 1.2s, reflecting every attack, then rings to strike the area
Slam the ground and seven vajras rise ahead one by one, splitting the path and launching enemies
The sky splits and a huge golden palm presses down on the area. Pinned enemies are held long while the ground shakes three times
Fully awaken the Ghost Kick and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, beat your shadow-only shadow in the Awakening Trial
In your reborn body, your shadow walks on its own. A beat after your foot lands, the shadow's foot lands there too. Foes get hit twice but see it once.

Shadow Kick: when a light or heavy hit lands, your shadow kicks the same spot again a beat later (45%). Three dashes, 1.7x from behind. Secret Art Night Parade: eight shadows cross the area and trample
Step on shadows and leap behind the three nearest enemies in turn, kicking each (invincible, all critical from behind)
Your shadow spreads to grab enemies' feet. 1.2s later the shadows rise and kick them all at once
Night Parade of a Hundred Ghosts
The world darkens and eight shadows rise from the ground. They crisscross between enemies trampling twelve times, then gather at the center and kick everyone into the sky (invincible meanwhile)
Fully awaken the Flowing Palm and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, beat your water shadow in the Awakening Trial
Your reborn body has become water. Deflected force doesn't vanish; it turns into waves that sweep the area. Water doesn't fight. It just covers everything.

Backflow: wide deflect window (0.3s), and each deflect bursts a wave that pushes enemies away. Secret Art Flowing Under Heaven: three water dragons coil around you sweeping the area, then merge and crash forward
Push a wall of water with both hands. For 1s waves keep rolling in a cone ahead, pushing enemies and wearing their balance
A water pillar rises underfoot, launching nearby enemies; jets of water slam down on them
Three water dragons coil around you and rise, sweeping the area for 2.6s. At the end they merge into one giant wave and crash forward
Fully awaken the Blazing Fire Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your fire shadow
An undying karmic fire has awakened in your reborn body. The fire doesn't stop at burning its target. When they fall, it bursts and engulfs everyone nearby.

Karmic Fire: enemies hit burn harder for 4s. When a burning enemy falls, it explodes and burns the area. Secret Art Fire Dragon Inferno: a fire dragon circles the sky and slams into enemies; where it lands turns to lava and bursts
Become flame and pierce forward (invincible). Your path bursts into fire pillars a beat later
Strike the ground to raise eight fire pillars ahead one by one
A fire dragon rises from you, circles the sky and slams into enemies four times. At the end the impact points turn to lava and burst three times
Fully awaken the Azure Sea Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your sea shadow
The deep sea has awakened in your reborn body. Waves come more often and deeper. No one has ever seen the bottom of the sea.

Deep Sea: every three hits a big water pillar rises at the target (wider and stronger). Knockback x1.4. Secret Art Deep Sea Descends: the ground becomes deep sea, enemies sink, and a giant water pillar launches them skyward
Slide on the current and pierce through (invincible). Water pillars rise along your path
A water pillar rises underfoot, launching nearby enemies; jets of water slam down
The ground ahead becomes deep sea. Enemies sink and can't move for 1.8s, then a giant water pillar rises at the center and launches them all
Fully awaken the Wind God Kick and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your wind shadow
Blades of wind have awakened in your reborn body. A blade lingers wherever your feet pass, and the blades gather into a tornado that reaches the sky.

Blade Wind: two dashes, dash cooldown 0.4s, knockback x1.5, faster. Secret Art Heavenly Wind Myriad Blades: twelve wind blades circle you, shoot out in all directions, then a giant tornado lifts everything
Pierce through like the wind (invincible). Wind blades on your path cut a beat later
Raise a blade-wind tornado ahead for 2.5s. It pulls in and keeps cutting nearby enemies
Twelve wind blades coil around you cutting the area, then shoot out in all directions. At the end a towering tornado ahead lifts and hurls everyone
Fully awaken the Limitless Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your ink-painted shadow
In your reborn body, the Limitless has taken up the brush. Beyond black and white, everything is drawn and erased from a single drop of ink. Ink spreads where your fingers pass and burns gold.

Ink Bleed: every four hits ink spreads under the target and bursts gold. Every hit wears balance twice as fast. Secret Art Limitless Brush: a great brush in the sky paints an ink flower on the ground, and the painting burns gold and explodes
Swing your arm wide and draw one ink stroke in the air. A thick stroke cuts 26 studs ahead, slicing enemies, and 0.5s later it burns gold and bursts again
Draw a big ink circle underfoot in one go. Enemies inside are stuck in ink for 1s, and when the circle closes an ink wall rises and collapses in gold

A great brush appears in the sky and paints an ink flower around you. Eight swirling strokes come down one by one, cutting enemies beneath, then a circle closes around it all and the painting burns gold and explodes
Fully awaken the Plum Blossom Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your snow-bloom shadow
Midwinter plum has bloomed in your reborn body. Like plum that blooms redder as snow piles up, branches stretch wherever your fingers pass and flowers burst in the snow.

Snow Plum: every five hits a plum branch grows under the target, blooms and bursts (snow slows them briefly). Full petals make your heavy strike bloom. Secret Art Plum in Snow: snow falls as red petals swirl around you, then a giant plum blooms in the sky and petals pour down
Reach out and a plum branch grows 24 studs along the ground. Flowers bloom at each joint, cutting, then all of them burst at once
Five big plum flowers bloom around you. They pull nearby enemies into their stamens, then burst with a blizzard (enemies hit are slowed for 1s)
Heavy snow falls around you for 2s while red petals swirl and keep cutting. At the end a giant plum blooms in the sky and petals pour like rain
Fully awaken the Drunken Fist and gain two insights, then, after one rebirth, find the Awakening Master and beat your drunken shadow
The eight immortals are drunk with you in your reborn body. Wine from the gourd flows like a river, and every stagger becomes an immortal's step.

Drunken Immortal: 30% chance to dodge attacks automatically. Every four hits wine splashes at the target and dizzies them. Secret Art Eight Immortals Descend: shadows of the eight immortals appear and pounce one by one, then a giant gourd slams down from the sky
Three wobbly steps, lurching left and right as you lunge 9 studs each (invincible). Kick the area each time you land
Tip the gourd and pour a river of wine ahead. For 2s enemies on it are slowed and soaked, then the river catches fire and burns all at once
Shadows of the eight immortals appear and pounce on nearby enemies one by one. At the end a giant gourd slams down from the sky and wine bursts in all directions
Ten Thousand Demons in a Sea of Blood
The ground becomes a sea of blood. Demon claws rise from it twelve times to tear enemies (healing you each time), then the sea erupts into a blood-red whirlpool pillar. Then 10s of frenzy
Nine gold dragons burst from the ground and coil into the sky. They circle and slam into enemies one by one, then gather at the center and explode
Link ten nearby enemies with a net of purple lightning. The net pulses five times frying them, then heavenly thunder falls on each
A giant many-armed golden Tathagata rises behind you and strikes enemies eight times in turn. At the end the sky splits and a huge palm presses the ground
The world darkens and you vanish. A red mark is carved on each enemy, and the moment light returns they all burst at once. Finally a shadow foot stomps from the sky (invincible meanwhile)
